# Components

## Rules

1. Only the components in the allow-list below exist. If a name is not on it, do not import it.
2. Before using a component, run `ds docs get <Component>` and use only the props it prints.
3. Components do not accept `style` or `className`. Use their props.

## Allow-list

<!-- generated:allow-list:start -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/build-docs.ts. Do not edit between these markers. -->

These are the only exports of `@ds`, read from `packages/ds/src/index.ts`.

### Alert

A short, colored message that tells the user about the result of an action or the state of the page. Read its docs: `ds docs get Alert`

### Button

Triggers an action, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog. Read its docs: `ds docs get Button`

### Card

A bordered surface that groups related content, such as a form or a settings section. Read its docs: `ds docs get Card`

### Heading

A page or section title. Renders the matching `<h1>` to `<h3>` element. Read its docs: `ds docs get Heading`

### Stack

Lays out children in a row or column with consistent spacing between them. `Stack` is the only layout primitive in this design system. Read its docs: `ds docs get Stack`

### TextField

A single-line text input with a built-in label and error message. Read its docs: `ds docs get TextField`

### Other exports

- Functions: `token`
- Types: `AlertProps`, `ButtonProps`, `CardProps`, `HeadingProps`, `SpaceToken`, `StackProps`, `TextFieldProps`, `TokenPath`

### Not exported

These names are common mistakes. They do not exist.

- `Box`: use `Stack`
- `Container`: use `Stack`
- `Flex`: use `Stack`
- `Grid`: use `Stack`

<!-- generated:allow-list:end -->

## Failure mode: importing a component that does not exist

Incorrect:

```tsx
import { Box, Button } from "@ds";

<Box>
  <Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
</Box>
```

Correct:

```tsx
import { Button, Stack } from "@ds";

<Stack>
  <Button variant="primary">Save</Button>
</Stack>
```

`ds check` reports: `Box is not exported by @ds. Use Stack (see: ds docs get Stack).`

## Failure mode: relying on trained knowledge instead of `ds docs get`

Incorrect: props guessed from other libraries.

```tsx
<TextField placeholder="Email" variant="outlined" fullWidth />
<Button color="primary" size="large">Sign in</Button>
```

Correct: run `ds docs get TextField` and `ds docs get Button` first, then use the props they list.

```tsx
<TextField label="Email" name="email" type="email" />
<Button variant="primary" type="submit">Sign in</Button>
```

## Failure mode: skipping `ds check` before declaring a task done

Incorrect: "I've added the settings page." (no check was run)

Correct: run `pnpm ds check`, fix every problem it prints, run it again, and report the passing result. A task is not complete until `ds check` passes.
